capture_source.GPU: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5070 Ti Laptop GPU

frame_numbering: frame is zero-based enqueue index; source_frame is one-based JPEG frame

methods.frame_mapping: One ordered F02/F05 pair per frame; each F05 host API window has exactly one D graph launch (310 kernels) and one M tail graph launch (9 kernels). Both graph roles and actual D/M stream IDs verified by matching all 60 node/graph capture launch orders. Frame0 has extra TensorRT warmup/capture work and is retained but excluded from steady statistics; frame1 is first Execute.
methods.same_frame_F06: flow_input start through flow_output end, including the final motion-image write; excludes later flow_mask and predict. Full interval includes CUDA and indirect fixed-function work/waits.
methods.OFA_bound: flow_input end through flow_cells start. This is an indirect enclosing interval, not OFA engine activity or exact latency.
methods.D_next_activity: CUDA kernels of F02/F05/F03/producer/F04 for n+1; excludes nvJPEG private stream, JPEG hardware, H2D and OFA hardware.
methods.M_tail_activity: Post-candidate flow_mask plus all 9 real CUDA kernels of the n-th M graph, ending at packet; excludes earlier F06/predict and subsequent D2H. Separate M_graph fields omit flow_mask.
methods.actual_overlap: Intersect union of actual kernel start/end intervals across both roles; no stage gap or engine bound counted as kernel busy.
methods.envelope_overlap: Intersect minimum-start/maximum-end bounding intervals; includes gaps and is reported separately.

limits: Historical clean fae5cb7 capture, driver 617.42, G1, same fixed HR engine; not a fresh trace of 3cbaa518f0dc.
Nsight Systems node instrumentation changes execution timing; these numbers are schedule evidence, not unprofiled latency or current FPS.
OFA fixed-function engine is not directly visible; F06/OFA intervals do not measure OFA utilization.
Kernel activity overlap does not establish occupancy, speedup or absence of races; original sanitizer OPEN/FAIL remains.
